CdnConfigObservation.title: CdnConfigObservation
CdnConfigObservation.description: One CDN configuration the build was advertised with. CDNConfig is not part of the build identity; each republished one is kept with the newest versions-row receipt per region.

cdnConfig.description: The CDN configuration this projection is bound to: the newest advertised one in discovery pages, or the exact one an open or admission was made with.

cdnConfigHistory.description: Every CDN configuration this build was advertised with, newest first, capped to the newest 16.

cdnConfigHistoryCount.description: How many CDN configurations the build has in total. When it exceeds cdnConfigHistory's length, the older ones are omitted from this projection but kept in the catalog.

severity.description: problem: the check did not get everything it asked for. note: a regional fact about the official source that leaves the check complete (D076).

ProductDiscoveryStatus.title: ProductDiscoveryStatus
ProductDiscoveryStatus.description: The saved outcome of one product's latest check, the same facts a single-product DiscoveryPage carries without its builds.

ProductRefreshProblem.title: ProductRefreshProblem
ProductRefreshProblem.description: A product whose part of a cross-product refresh did not complete. Its saved evidence is unchanged.

DiscoveryCatalogPage.title: DiscoveryCatalogPage
DiscoveryCatalogPage.description: One bounded page of builds across every registered product, ordered by registry product order, then numeric BuildId descending (missing or non-decimal last), then build identity.

productId.description: The Product filter this page was read with; null reads every product.

products.description: Every registered product's saved status in registry order, whatever the Product filter.

refreshProblems.description: Products whose refresh attempt did not complete. Always empty for discovery.readAll.

InventoryFilesParams.title: InventoryFilesParams
InventoryFilesParams.description: inventory.files: one bounded page of Files rows (D068). Every filter tests single memberships; a file is listed when one membership passes all of them.

contentKey.description: Full lowercase CKey, or a prefix of at least four hex digits.

localeFlags.description: Raw locale mask; a membership matches when it shares a bit.

contentFlags.description: none (derived content flags are zero), or a raw mask whose bits must all be set.

InventoryFileParams.title: InventoryFileParams
InventoryFileParams.description: inventory.file: every membership of one Files row, in membership order, marked against the same filters.

contentKey.description: Full lowercase CKey, or a prefix of at least four hex digits.

localeFlags.description: Raw locale mask; a membership matches when it shares a bit.

contentFlags.description: none (derived content flags are zero), or a raw mask whose bits must all be set.

InventoryFile.title: InventoryFile
InventoryFile.description: One ROOT FileDataID or one exact install name with every membership summarized. Sizes are encoded bytes of resolved memberships; unresolved ones are counted, never sized.

membershipCount.description: Every membership of the file; sealing refuses a file with more than 4,096.

anyOf.description: Union of the raw ROOT locale masks; null for install files.
Files in the chosen family; null whenever another filter narrows the list.

scanLimited.description: The engine stopped at its per-request examination bound before filling the page; nextCursor continues the search.

InventoryRawContentFlags.title: InventoryRawContentFlags
InventoryRawContentFlags.description: The three raw ROOT block parts; the derived content flags are first | second | (third << 17).

FileCatalogParams.title: FileCatalogParams
FileCatalogParams.description: inventory.catalog: where one opened build's file catalog stands (D071). One bounded read; it never starts a transfer, count or check.

FileCatalogSummary.title: FileCatalogSummary
FileCatalogSummary.description: A sealed ROOT/install file catalog (profile files-root-install-v1). Every count is exact.

unresolvedMembershipCount.description: Memberships whose CKey has no sized encoded object in ENCODING: no EKey and no encoded size, never zero.

storedMembershipCount.description: Memberships whose EKey was verified locally when the row was written.

detail.description: The underlying storage or I/O cause, for diagnosis.

FileCatalogList.title: FileCatalogList
FileCatalogList.description: inventory.catalogs: the preparations Downloads & activity shows (pending, stopped or failed), most recently opened first.

FileCatalogSetParams.title: FileCatalogSetParams
FileCatalogSetParams.description: inventory.catalog.set: stop a pending preparation, or resume a stopped, failed or removed one.

FileCatalogStatus.title: FileCatalogStatus
FileCatalogStatus.description: inventory.catalog reply (D071). pending carries its stage (and written memberships while writing); ready carries the sealed catalog Files reads; failed (after three attempts) and unsupported carry the cause, and the next Open retries both. removed: freed from Settings (D085); the next Open or resume prepares it again.

TableColumnNarrowing.title: TableColumnNarrowing
TableColumnNarrowing.description: D079: the column's 32-bit pallet or common values are wider than its definition, and each value keeps its low usedBits bits, signed or unsigned per the definition.

schemaMatch.description: layoutOnly: no definition block lists this build; the file's layout hash chose the block (D080). Omitted: a block lists the exact build and layout.

SummaryRevision.title: SummaryRevision
SummaryRevision.description: Opaque engine-run epoch and change count (D077). Compare for equality only.

CreatureAppearanceManifest.title: CreatureAppearanceManifest
CreatureAppearanceManifest.description: VMA1 textured appearance manifest; see contracts/geometry-vma1-v1.md.

CreatureGeometryAppearance.title: CreatureGeometryAppearance
CreatureGeometryAppearance.description: Textured draw of a ready geometry pair; see contracts/creature-geometry-v1.md#appearance.

PreparedDataFreeParams.title: PreparedDataFreeParams
PreparedDataFreeParams.description: settings.storage.free: one opened build whose file catalog is freed (D085).

PreparedFileCatalog.title: PreparedFileCatalog
PreparedFileCatalog.description: A build's file catalog: its state (none when it was never queued) and the bytes and count of its files on disk, measured when read. Only this build uses them.

PreparedTables.title: PreparedTables
PreparedTables.description: The table row files the build's admissions use, each counted once, and the bytes another build also uses. Kept by settings.storage.free.

PreparedDownloads.title: PreparedDownloads
PreparedDownloads.description: The build's stored download figure (D065). Stored objects are shared with every build that lists them. Kept by settings.storage.free.

PreparedBuild.title: PreparedBuild
PreparedBuild.description: What one opened build holds locally (D085).

PreparedDataList.title: PreparedDataList
PreparedDataList.description: settings.storage.builds: every opened build, most recently opened first, at most 256; truncated when more were opened.

PreparedDataFreed.title: PreparedDataFreed
PreparedDataFreed.description: settings.storage.free reply: the bytes and files deleted and the file catalog as measured after.
